title: The Lost Sentry is the only hostile encountered in ~130 rooms with zero grace/wits/will bypass. It is tagged 'attacks on sight' (not 'holds its ground' like every other undead) and struck for 3hp on room-entry with no dialogue offered; only 'attack' or retreat to another exit were available, breaking the pattern every other encounter (barrow-wight, ash wolf, gaunt wolf, gray sergeant, peat-black wight, honour guard, frozen pilgrim) established of a talk/verse/slip-past option.
